### US Foods to Present at the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference


08/26/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/460693622/files/doc_news/US-Foods-to-Present-at-the-Barclays-19th-Annual-Global-Consumer-Conference-2026.pdf)


ROSEMONT, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD) announced today that Dirk Locascio, Chief Financial Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Barclays 19th Annual Global Consumer Conference in Boston on Wednesday, Sept. 9, at 1:30 p.m. EDT.


Media and investors can listen to a live audio webcast by visiting the Investor Relations page of the company’s website at[https://ir.usfoods.com/events-and-presentations/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fnam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fir.usfoods.com%252Fevents-and-presentations%252Fdefault.aspx%26data%3D05%257C02%257CTheresa.Ingala%2540usfoods.com%257C9969be5416b94c3374cc08df01e7ab2b%257C832c6ba93f7845f3b4b0d28c2893ca8a%257C0%257C0%257C639231766675327912%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3D8497A9frQxfvLno6uqocDEV1iIDX2ExxAkrwp0EJ%252BTI%253D%26reserved%3D0&esheet=54593979&newsitemid=20260826953193&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.usfoods.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&index=1&md5=dc8467169720cd54a2924305b4946a2b) . A replay of the webcast will be available later that same day.


**About US Foods**


With a promise to help its customers Make It, US Foods is one of America’s great food companies and a leading foodservice distributor, partnering with approximately 250,000 customer locations to help their businesses succeed. With more than 70 broadline locations and more than 90 cash and carry stores, US Foods and its 30,000 associates provides its customers with a broad and innovative food offering and a comprehensive suite of e-commerce, technology and business solutions. US Foods is headquartered in Rosemont, Ill. Visit[www.usfoods.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.usfoods.com&esheet=54593979&newsitemid=20260826953193&lan=en-US&anchor=www.usfoods.com&index=2&md5=73e531df9d74095f92158eaf22729332) to learn more.
